name: cine-sleuth
description: Evidence-backed video breakdowns for dialogue, scenes, shots, pacing, visual language, and sound.

interface.shortDescription: Break down dialogue, scenes, shots, pacing, and sound.
interface.longDescription: Accept a local video, preserve its source timeline, extract structured audiovisual evidence, and let the host agent author a complete shot-by-shot breakdown.
defaultPrompt: 对这个视频做完整拉片，输出逐句台词、物理场景、逐镜表和视听分析。
提取这个视频的全部台词和屏幕文字，保留精确时间码。
拆解这条短视频的开场钩子、内容结构、节奏、字幕和声音设计。
